name: Priya Sharma
text: The Banarasi saree I ordered for my sister's wedding was even more beautiful in person. The zari work is stunning and the fall of the fabric is perfect.

name: Ananya Reddy
text: Krishna Collections has become my go-to for festive sarees. The quality always matches the photos, and packaging is very premium.

name: Kavita Nair
text: Loved the Kanjivaram silk saree — rich colour and lovely border. Delivery was quick and the blouse piece was a perfect match.

name: Simran Kaur
text: Bought my bridal saree here and could not be happier. The kundan work is intricate and the customer support helped me pick the right size.
